text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Bahrain's emir is briefed on plans and designs of a $5 million hospital to be built in Bahrain.
- Most Arab countries oppose taking part in an economic meeting attended by Israel in Qatar in November because of the Jewish state's policies on Middle East peace, an Arab League official says.
- Kuwaiti interior minister arrives in Bahrain on Monday on an official two-day visit.
- Arab countries can no longer ignore the vital need for an Arab economic bloc if they are to play a role in the new global trade arena, an international trade expert says.
- Cabinet on Sunday welcomes Arab and international efforts to rescue the Middle East peace process and stresses the importance of the role played by Syria in the region.
- A Saudi holding investment corporation to be established in Bahrain with a capital of $150 million. There are 30 investment banks in Bahrain with combined capital of $4 billion.
- Bahrain Middle East Bank signs on Sunday a $75 million syndicated loan facility to finance long-term investments.
